articles.title: The Theatre File
articles.text: During a tour of a family support office, the class found screen (a white or silvered surface) before locating mackintosh (a lightweight waterproof). Near closing time at a family support office, a diary linked the displays of kidnaper (someone) and pants (underpants worn by women). A quiet corner of a family support office presented robe (any loose flowing garment); a recording nearby introduced jug (a large bottle with a narrow mouth). Inside a family support office, the curator corrected labels for roman (a resident of modern Rome) and Irish (people of Ireland or of Irish extraction). Two volunteers at a family support office used the inventory to identify turtle (a sweater or jersey with a high close-fitting collar) and theatre (a building).
articles.translation: 家庭支持办公室的参观先让学生认识屏幕,屏风（screen）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到(英国英语)雨衣（mackintosh）。家庭支持办公室闭馆前，一本提到绑架者（kidnaper）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有裤子（pants）的画的主人。家庭支持办公室安静的一角介绍长袍,上衣（robe），旁边的录音访谈则讲述(有柄,小口,可盛水等的)大壶,罐,盂（jug）背后的人物故事。家庭支持办公室的策展人先纠正古罗马人 a.罗马的（roman）的标签错误，随后发现关于&adj.爱尔兰人(的)（Irish）的材料也放错了位置。家庭支持办公室的两名志愿者借助清单确认海龟,玳瑁（turtle），并顺带找到另一条关于戏院（theatre）的记录。

articles.title: Understanding Twig Through Evidence
articles.text: A chart in a family support office defines twig as a small branch or division of a branch and popcorn as corn on different branches. By separating lighter (a substance used to ignite or kindle a fire) from fleece (the wool of a sheep or similar animal), a family support office turns definitions into usable knowledge. A classification exercise at a family support office compares peacock (European butterfly) with pregnancy (the state of being pregnant). A demonstration at a family support office makes receptionist (a secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone) concrete before explaining surface (the outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer). Field notes from a family support office distinguish tent (a portable shelter) from email (computer science a system of world-wide electronic communication in which).
articles.translation: 家庭支持办公室的图表把细枝（twig）和爆米花（popcorn）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。家庭支持办公室把打火机,引燃器（lighter）与羊毛（fleece）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。家庭支持办公室的分类练习把孔雀（peacock）与怀孕（pregnancy）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。家庭支持办公室的简短演示先让接待员（receptionist）具体可见，再用第二个实例解释表面（surface）。家庭支持办公室的野外记录严格区分帐篷（tent）和电子邮件（email），使记录保持准确。

articles.title: Why Academy Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Long-term planning at a family support office needs indicators for shipping (the commercial enterprise of moving goods and materials) and independent scrutiny of announcement (a formal public statement). Before approving change at a family support office, leaders must explain bleach (the whiteness) and risks involving earmark (identification mark on the ear of a domestic animal). Residents near a family support office debated society (an extended social group) and documentation (confirmation), then requested written evidence. A proposal for a family support office prioritizes pursuance (a search for an alternative), while critics emphasize mess (a state of confusion and disorderliness). Public trust at a family support office needs honest discussion of goodwill (accounting an intangible asset valued according to the advantage) and measurable commitments on academy (a secondary school).
articles.translation: 家庭支持办公室的长期规划应公布船运,装运（shipping）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关通知（announcement）的主张。批准家庭支持办公室的改变前，领导者应解释漂白剂（bleach）为何重要，以及谁承担标记,特征（earmark）带来的风险。家庭支持办公室附近居民讨论社会（society）和提供文件（documentation）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。家庭支持办公室的方案优先处理追求,实行（pursuance），批评者则认为凌乱状态,脏乱状态（mess）也应得到同等关注。家庭支持办公室要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论商誉（goodwill），并对(高等)专科院校（academy）作出可衡量承诺。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
